{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS334 |prevtitle=The Final Battle VII |nextcode=PS336 |nexttitle=The Final Battle IX |series=Emerald |colorscheme=Emerald}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=The Final Battle VIII |subtitle=Triple × Triple |title_ja=大決戦VIII |title_ro=The Final Battle VIII |image=PS335.png |scheme=Emerald |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 335 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|29}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 335 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|29}} |location={{gdis|Battle Tower|III}} }} '''The Final Battle VIII''' (Japanese: '''大決戦VII''' ''The Final Battle VII''), titled '''The Final Showdown VIII''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 335th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 33rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Emerald}}. It is subtitled '''Triple × Triple''' (Japanese: '''トリプルＸトリプル''' ''Triple X Triple'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Triple X Triple''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Guile Hideout]] is surrounded by clones of [[Poli]] created by {{m|Double Team}}. While he attempts to find out the real one, [[Polibo]] suddenly appears in front of Guile. Polibo delivers an attack, knocking Guile to the ground. {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Gold}} reveal that the strategy was one that they practiced on [[Mt. Silver]]. Angered, Guile sends out his {{p|Walrein}} to attack along with his {{p|Surskit}}. His Surskit immediately evolves into {{p|Masquerain}}, but it and Walrein are stopped by Poli and Polibo, who proceed to toss them onto the ground. Poli and Polibo quickly leap into the air and deliver a powerful chop at Guile. The attacks causes Guile's armor to break and fall off, revealing a shocked [[Archie]] underneath. Gold mocks Archie and asks if the others are ready. {{adv|Ruby}}, {{adv|Sapphire}}, {{adv|Yellow}}, {{adv|Green}}, {{adv|Silver}}, and {{adv|Blue}} all stand in a line with their Pokémon. Although they lined up like Gold instructed, Ruby and Sapphire wonder how they will get the monster {{p|Kyogre}} out of the water. Gold reveals that his [[Pibu]] is working with {{adv|Red}}'s [[Pika]] and Yellow's [[Chuchu]] to lure the Kyogre out by shocking the water repeatedly. The attack works, and the monster Kyogre leaps out of the water, knocking Pibu, Pika, and Chuchu away. Ruby and Sapphire pull Red and Gold up to help, but Archie grabs Gold and tells him that he won't get away. He states that even though they managed to beat the [[rental Pokémon]] from the {{gdis|Battle Tower|III}}, he will just gather the rest to attack. {{adv|Emerald}} dares him to do it, as he claims that none of them will listen to him anyway. Emerald reveals that while Archie was distracted, he covered the entire {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}} in his E Shooter's formation. Outside the Battle Frontier, {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latias}}, {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios}}, [[Scott]], and [[Todd Snap]] all surround the entire area with the formation. Gold drops Archie by revealing that he was holding one of Emerald's fake hands the entire time. Gold and Emerald climb to the top of the Battle Tower and prepare to attack the monster Kyogre. Silver, Ruby, and Green command {{TP|Silver|Feraligatr}}, [[Mumu]], and [[Blasty]] to use {{m|Hydro Cannon}}. Blue, Sapphire, and Gold have {{TP|Blue|Charizard}}, [[Chic]], and [[Exbo]] attack with {{m|Blast Burn}}. Lastly, Red, Crystal, and Emerald have [[Saur]], [[Megaree]], and {{TP|Emerald|Sceptile}} use {{m|Frenzy Plant}}. ==Major events== * [[Guile Hideout]]'s armor is destroyed by [[Poli]] and [[Polibo]]. * The monster {{p|Kyogre}} is attacked by a combination of {{m|Frenzy Plant}}, {{m|Hydro Cannon}}, and {{m|Blast Burn}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Silver}} * {{adv|Crystal}} * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * {{adv|Emerald}} * [[Todd Snap]] * [[Scott]] * [[Guile Hideout]]/[[Archie]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poliwrath}} ([[Poli]];
